objective: Define a resident execution optimization benchmark for the weak decode-like repeated single-state prefill/decode shape.

candidate.intended_effect: keep the single decode-like state resident on device across repeated eval steps and reduce per-step host/device overhead
candidate.patch_policy: no per-step patch script for this first gate; use the same sanitized initial state and step count as the non-resident 1x32 baseline
candidate.init_state_policy: CPU state images used as GPU init-state must be sanitized with --sanitize-host-only-internals before upload

run_result.initial_failure: CUDA illegal memory access when uploading an unsanitized CPU state image as GPU init-state
run_result.initial_failure_location: src/hybrid/run_vl_hybrid.c:1436 during final cuCtxSynchronize after launching from an unsanitized init-state
run_result.trace_observation: The failing 1x1 trace reaches before_first_kernel_launch, after_first_kernel_launch, and before_final_sync before CUDA error 700, so module load, kernel resolution, allocation, and init-state upload complete before the device fault is reported.
run_result.diagnosis: The failure was caused by unsanitized host-only Verilator state in the CPU state image, not by resident_steps itself.
run_result.interpretation: With sanitized CPU init-state, resident_steps preserves coverage-output equivalence and materially reduces the weak 1x32 repeated decode wall time for this harness.

measurement_policy.interpretation: A faster resident candidate would support a narrow claim that repeated decode-like single-state launch overhead is reducible for this RTL harness only.

claim_scope: definition of a resident execution optimization gate for one prefill/decode split paged KV-cache shape
non_claims: not reviewed resident execution speedup claim
not low-precision or compressed KV cache
